messages:
samir: Customer reports streaming JSON payloads getting a truncated final object when using our SSE endpoint. They say it works if they don't stream, but with streaming the last '}' is sometimes missing. Example curl they sent:

samir: ```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?mode=json" --no-buffer
```

kristen: thanks, forwarding to infra + logs. any reproducible steps on their side?

samir: yes, customer repros reliably by sending a long prompt that produces multiple JSON chunks (~50KB). They see last chunk dropped ~10% of the runs.

ops-bot: deploybot: rollout v2.14.1 to prod finished 2026-03-17T08:02:21Z :rocket:

ben: can you paste a raw capture of the response (first/last 2 chunks)? also want client-side TCP logs if possible.

samir: pasted the raw response (newline separated chunks). note final chunk missing trailing brace: ```
data: {"id":"abc","state":"partial","items":[{"x":1}]}
data: {"id":"abc","state":"partial","items":[{"x":2}]}
data: {"id":"abc","state":"final","items":[{"x":3}]}
```

ev an: typo in name, evan: looks like an early FIN from an intermediate proxy. saw similar when CloudFront / ALB idle timeouts cut an open SSE stream if no data for 29s. Do we have keepalive heartbeats enabled?

kristen: heartbeat is optional; Optimize previously disabled heartbeats for small payloads to reduce overhead.

ben: repro checklist I'm running locally: 1) curl --no-buffer to SSE; 2) simulate slow token generation with `sleep` between tokens; 3) run through our staging gateway vs direct edge. I can repro a truncated tail hitting our edge lambda when the connection idle > 25s.

samir: customer env: request goes through CF -> corp-proxy -> lb -> api. They use CloudFront with default KeepAlive TTL.

evan: hypothesis: intermediate hop (corp-proxy) closes TCP after X idle seconds without flushing chunked buffer, so last chunk isn't sent before FIN. When FIN arrives, kernel drops incomplete chunk tail causing broken JSON.

ben: logs from our edge show `write failed: connection reset by peer` right after we flushed last chunk. snippet: ```
[edge-123] INFO stream chunk seq=124 flushed
[edge-123] ERROR write failed: ConnectionResetError(104)
[edge-123] INFO tear down stream client_ip=1.2.3.4
```

kristen: recommended fix for now: enable periodic SSE heartbeats (small comment frames, e.g., `:\n`) every 15s so intermediate proxies don't consider the connection idle. Also add a final `\n` flush and explicit `data: {"complete":true}` before closing to ensure complete JSON emitted.

samir: shared a minimal server-side patch customer can apply while we work infra side: 
```js
// pseudo-node SSE: send JSON chunks and a heartbeat every 12s
res.write(`data: ${chunk}\n\n`); // chunk
setInterval(() => res.write(':\n\n'), 12000); // heartbeat
// on end:
res.write('data: {"meta":"end"}\n\n'); res.end();
```

evan: infra action items: 1) verify CF / ALB keepalive and idle timeouts in prod; 2) check if edge lambda layer buffers stdout when connection reset occurs; 3) consider default enabling lightweight heartbeats on streaming endpoints.

ben: created repro runbook (private gist) with curl + tcpdump steps and perf flags. sharing in the ticket.

kristen: customer update: asked them to enable heartbeat patch and report back. Also asked for tcpdump showing FIN timing relative to last chunk.

samir: customer returned tcpdump: shows FIN from corp-proxy 150ms after last chunk write attempt. Looks like proxy aggressively closes cached connections.

evan: short-term customer workaround: 1) disable streaming for critical calls (non-ideal) OR 2) enable heartbeats as above OR 3) set `Connection: keep-alive` tweaks on proxy if they control it.

kristen: long-term: infra to evaluate default heartbeat + docs page describing streaming pitfalls (proxies, keepalive, chunking). Also add a QA test that simulates proxy FIN during SSE to detect regressions.

samir: tagging followups: @ben please paste repro gist, @evan please open infra ticket with CF/ALB config checks, I'll coordinate customer communications.

ben: done, gist link sent in ticket :link: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: ticket#SUP-6578 created (streaming-json-truncation)

kristen: closing loop for now; customer rolled heartbeat patch and confirmed stable for 48h. They still want guidance for on-prem proxies — I'll draft a doc. :white_check_mark:
